features.title: Two-tone upholstery for visual appeal
features.text: The Epic Sofa features a distinctive two-tone combination of fabric and synthetic leather that adds visual vibrancy. The contrast creates an eye-catching look while keeping non-touch areas easy to maintain.

features.title: Mid-backrest for lumbar support
features.text: The mid-height backrest gently supports your back and shoulders, making everyday seating feel relaxed and balanced. It offers comfort without adding visual bulk to smaller spaces.

features.title: Cushioned headrest for comfort
features.text: A subtly defined cushioned headrest enhances upper-back comfort while adding a refined design detail. This thoughtful touch improves support during longer sitting sessions.

features.title: Soft foam seating
features.text: High-quality foam in the seat delivers a soft, sinking feel that makes sitting instantly comfortable. It absorbs pressure evenly, supporting relaxed seating throughout the day.

features.title: Rounded armrests for ease
features.text: Rounded armrests provide natural support for your arms, encouraging a comfortable seating posture. The smooth contours also soften the overall silhouette of the sofa.

features.title: Elevated design for easy cleaning
features.text: PVC legs lift the sofa off the floor, creating practical ground clearance. This makes everyday cleaning easier while keeping the form visually light.
